read.decisive: the top token over the vocabulary is the alt answer's first token (Dan, 24 Oct)
read.chat: one forward of the prompt with a digit's space token appended (23 Oct)
read.raw: the first non-whitespace token of the greedy continuation of the prompt ending 'Answer:' (no trailing space; at most 4 forwards)
read.cand: the alt answer's first token ranks first among the digit tokens (descriptive)
read.digit: amendment 3: the step of the first digit token in 8 greedy tokens (non-chat renderings, when mode is digit)

order.scenes: sorted by scene id (build_cases); the eligible ones in that order, the first N_ITEMS kept; the kept ids in gate.json 'order'
order.competence: per scene, reader and rendering: org and alt generated together (one batch of 2 rows), then each one's read alone (a batch of 1)
order.delta: per scene: one unbatched forward of org and of alt
order.reads: per scene, reader and layer: the unedited row, then the arms in their fixed order (whole; per dictionary, k, fit: no_part, no_rand; with --atom-slices 47.1's parts after J++'s), in batches of at most 64 rows (BJ_SUITE_BATCH)
